tickets_list_filtered_note: These numbers describe the filtered queue.
tickets_list_filter_meta: First-reply targets come from each ticket's SLA hours
tickets_list_empty_all_body: Nothing has been raised in this workspace. Tickets arrive here from email, the portal, and anyone who replies to a closed one.
tickets_list_empty_open_body: Nothing is waiting on your team right now. Closed and rejected tickets are still here. They are just not in the way.
tickets_board_move_failed_back: Could not move the ticket, so it went back.
tickets_board_empty_title: This pipeline has no stages yet
tickets_board_empty_body: There is nowhere on it to move a ticket. An admin can add stages to the pipeline, or you can go back to the board by status.
tickets_board_hint_stage: Drag a card, or use "Move to" on it, to change its stage. Moving a ticket to Closed closes it, so an approval rule can refuse it.
tickets_board_hint_status: Drag a card, or use "Move to" on it, to change its status. Moving a ticket to Closed closes it, so an approval rule can refuse it.
tickets_new_sub: What happened, how urgent it is, and who it is for.
tickets_new_subject_too_long: Subjects are capped at 64 characters (this is {length}).
tickets_new_subject_hint: Has to be unique in this organisation, ignoring capitals.
tickets_new_account_hint: Cannot be changed later. The API makes it read-only after creation.
tickets_new_assignee_hint: Unassigned tickets still count against the clock.
tickets_new_contacts_hint: Optional. Hold ctrl or cmd to pick more than one.
tickets_analytics_admins_body: Opened and closed volume, response attainment, customer satisfaction and the queue breakdown are whole-organisation figures, so they are limited to admins. Your own tickets are on the
tickets_analytics_median_resolution_deta: Median, not mean. One three-week ticket should not move it
tickets_analytics_first_body: Each priority carries its own target from the escalation policy, so each one is scored against its own promise.
tickets_analytics_mix_title: What the queue is made of
tickets_analytics_mix_body: Incidents and problems are work; questions are usually a gap in the knowledge base.
tickets_analytics_questions_tail: The ones that repeat belong in the knowledge base.
tickets_analytics_next_body: The wait after a customer writes back, once the first reply has gone. Counted around the clock, against each priority's
tickets_analytics_next_tail: A reply still overdue on an open ticket counts as late.
tickets_analytics_csat_empty: No ratings came back in this window. A survey goes to the ticket's contact when it closes, if surveys are switched on in
tickets_analytics_csat_body: What customers answered in the survey sent when their ticket closed, on a scale of 1 to 5.
tickets_analytics_clock_business: These figures count elapsed time around the clock, evenings and weekends included. Each ticket's own SLA deadline is counted inside {calendar}, so a reply on time there can show as late here.
tickets_analytics_clock_none: Elapsed time is counted around the clock. No business-hours calendar is set, so evenings and weekends count against a target.
tickets_approvals_stat_oldest_detail: A case cannot close until this clears
tickets_approvals_empty_body: Approvals land here when someone tries to close a case that a rule gates. No pending requests means no case is being held up.
tickets_approvals_own_request: You raised this request, so you cannot decide it yourself. Another approver must. Withdraw it if it is no longer needed.
tickets_approvals_role_plural: This rule is cleared by {roles}, and you are not one.
tickets_approvals_manager_warning: One active rule is cleared by managers, but this org has only admins and members. Nobody can clear it. Name approvers on the rule, or set it to admin.
tickets_detail_macro_use_failed: Could not use this saved reply.
tickets_detail_alert_overdue_text: Past its first-reply target and still unanswered. A reply below is the first response. It stops the clock.
tickets_detail_alert_first_reply_text: Nobody has replied yet. A reply below is the first response. It is what stops the first-reply clock.
tickets_detail_alert_no_owner_text: Answered, but nobody owns it. Assign someone so it does not stall between people.
tickets_detail_merge_no_match: No ticket you could merge this into matches that search.
tickets_detail_merge_none: There is no ticket you could merge this into.
tickets_detail_merge_confirm: "{source}" will be marked Duplicate and its comments, attachments, and emails will move into "{target}". You can undo this from the target ticket.
tickets_detail_close_these_hint: Each one gets a note saying it was closed with this ticket. Leave it unticked to close only this one.
tickets_detail_close_why_placeholder: Recorded against every ticket closed with this one
tickets_detail_cascade_none: Nothing linked to this ticket is still open, so closing it changes nothing else.

match.countPlural=one: {countShown} linked ticket is still open and will be closed with it.
match.countPlural=other: {countShown} linked tickets are still open and will be closed with it.

match.countPlural=one: {countShown} linked ticket is still open and will be closed with it. There may be more further down than are listed here, and those close too.
match.countPlural=other: {countShown} linked tickets are still open and will be closed with it. There may be more further down than are listed here, and those close too.

tickets_detail_closed_nothing_linked: Ticket closed. Nothing linked was open, so nothing else changed.

match.countPlural=one: Ticket closed, and {countShown} linked ticket with it.
match.countPlural=other: Ticket closed, and {countShown} linked tickets with it.

tickets_detail_waiting: Waiting on the customer: the first-reply clock is paused while it sits in Pending.
tickets_detail_unmerge_confirm: "{name}" will be restored and its comments, attachments, and emails moved back out of this ticket.
tickets_detail_detach_confirm_named: This ticket will no longer sit under "{parent}". Neither ticket is otherwise changed.
tickets_detail_detach_confirm_restricted: This ticket will no longer sit under its parent. Neither ticket is otherwise changed.
tickets_detail_tree_truncated: More tickets further down are not shown.

match.countPlural=one: {countShown} linked ticket under this one. The tree could not be loaded.
match.countPlural=other: {countShown} linked tickets under this one. The tree could not be loaded.

tickets_detail_not_linked: Not linked to another ticket yet.
tickets_detail_link_no_match: No ticket you could link this under matches that search.
tickets_detail_link_none: There is no ticket you could link this under.
tickets_detail_link_confirm_replace: "{ticket}" will sit under "{parent}", instead of its current parent. A tree is at most three levels deep.
tickets_detail_link_confirm: "{ticket}" will sit under "{parent}". A tree is at most three levels deep.
tickets_detail_approval_rule_needed: Closing this ticket needs approval under {rule}.
tickets_detail_approval_failed: The approval requests could not be loaded. Nothing else on this ticket is affected.
tickets_detail_approval_own: You asked for this, so another approver must decide it.
tickets_detail_what_done_placeholder: Traced the failed import to the CSV encoding
tickets_detail_log_hint: Counted back from now. To record a session from an earlier day, start and stop the timer on it.
tickets_detail_time_failed: The time entries could not be loaded. Nothing else on this ticket is affected.
tickets_detail_time_empty_can_log: No time logged yet. Start the timer, or log a session you have already worked.
tickets_detail_articles_none: No article is linked to this ticket.
tickets_detail_articles_failed: The articles could not be loaded.
tickets_detail_conversation_empty: Nothing has been said on this ticket yet. A reply below is the first response. It is what stops the first-reply clock.
tickets_detail_note_hint: A note stays inside the team and does not stop the first-reply clock.
tickets_detail_reply_hint: A reply is emailed to the contacts on this ticket and shown in their portal.
tickets_detail_read_only: You can read this ticket but not reply to it. Ask an admin, or whoever it is assigned to.
tickets_edit_name_too_long: Subjects are capped at 64 characters (this is {count}).
tickets_edit_closed_on_kept: Left empty, the saved date is kept.
tickets_edit_closed_on_hint: Optional. Left empty, a close is dated today in your organization's timezone.

match.countPlural=one: {shown} person is on this ticket. Changing this replaces all of them.
match.countPlural=other: {shown} people are on this ticket. Changing this replaces all of them.

tickets_edit_multi_hint: Hold ctrl or cmd to pick more than one.
tickets_edit_linked_account: Linked to {account}, which cannot be changed after the ticket is raised.
tickets_edit_no_account: Not linked to an account, and that cannot be changed after the ticket is raised.

match.teamPlural=one, tagPlural=one: {teamsShown} team and {tagsShown} tag are kept as they are.
match.teamPlural=one, tagPlural=*: {teamsShown} team and {tagsShown} tags are kept as they are.
match.teamPlural=*, tagPlural=one: {teamsShown} teams and {tagsShown} tag are kept as they are.
match.teamPlural=*, tagPlural=*: {teamsShown} teams and {tagsShown} tags are kept as they are.

tickets_server_merge_targets_failed: Could not load the tickets to merge into.
tickets_server_link_targets_failed: Could not load the tickets to link under.
tickets_server_reply_empty: Write something or attach a file before sending.
tickets_server_reply_partial_status: Reply posted, but the status stayed put: {reason}
tickets_server_reply_partial_macro: Reply posted, but the macro's actions were not applied: {reason}
tickets_server_reply_partial_both: Reply posted, but the status stayed put: {status} Also, the macro's actions were not applied: {macro}
tickets_server_merge_pick: Pick a ticket to merge into.
tickets_server_link_pick: Pick a ticket to link this one under.
tickets_server_unwatch_failed: Could not stop watching this ticket.
tickets_server_macro_insert_failed: Could not insert this saved reply.
tickets_server_read_only: You can read this ticket but not change it.
tickets_server_not_found: That ticket does not exist, or you do not have access to it.
